The file size cannot exceed 10MB. Only the following file content types are supported: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`.

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization for which to upload a logo

uploader_user_id.description: The ID of the user that will be credited with the image upload.
